question: India becomes __________ nation having capabilities to shoot down fixed wing drone by laser beam.
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Fourth**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• India becomes 4th nation having capabilities to shoot down fixed wing drone by laser beam.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**India** successfully showcased its ability to shoot down **fixed-wing aircraft, missiles, and swarm drones** using a **30-kilowatt laser-based weapon system**.

 
 
• 
 
This achievement places India in an exclusive group of countries, including **US, China**, and **Russia**, with such a capability.

 
 
• 
 
The **successful trial** was conducted by the **Centre for High Energy Systems & Sciences (CHESS)** at **Kurnool, Andhra Pradesh**.

 
 
• 
 
The weapon system used in the trial:

 
 
• 
 
**Vehicle-mounted Laser Directed Energy Weapon (DEW MK-II(A))**.

 
 
• 
 
Successfully **disabled drones** and **fixed-wing UAVs**, causing **structural damage** and **disabling surveillance sensors**.

 
 
 
 
• 
 
India now joins the global powers with **high-power Laser DEW Systems**.

 
 
• 
 
DRDO is also working on **other high-energy technologies** like:

 
 
• 
 
**High-energy microwaves**

 
 
• 
 
**Electromagnetic pulse**

 
 
• 
 
Technologies with **Star Wars-like capabilities**.
